values.meaning: bonus movement speed while facing a nearby visible enemy champion
values.quote: gains {{sti|ms|{{as|30 '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy

mechanics.claim: The passive is a self-only movement speed buff, not a damage effect, so it does not affect a stationary-dummy damage fight.
mechanics.quote: gains {{sti|ms|{{as|30 '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}}

mechanics.claim: The bonus movement speed increases to 90 while Vayne is under the effects of Final Hour (R).
mechanics.quote: increased to {{as|90|ms}} while under the effects of ''{{ai|Final Hour|Vayne}}''

mechanics.claim: The buff requires facing a nearby enemy champion that is visible (in sight), and lingers 2 seconds after losing sight.
mechanics.quote: The '''bonus''' movement speed persists for 2 seconds after '''Vayne''' loses {{tip|sight}} of an enemy champion.
